# P06 · Practice Class UI, AI-layers overlay, audit viewer, staging — tasks

**Goal (3 lines):** Teachers rehearse in text on a phone (T5); judges switch on an overlay showing each turn's five layers, an AI map and an audit viewer.
Degraded states (slow call, budget reached, offline) are visible and kind. The transcript stays on the phone.
A staging deploy recipe and the round 3 test kit are ready; the live staging URL needs hosting accounts (human).
